description: This file implements packet handling functions for Git, including packet reading, writing, flushing, and sideband demultiplexing. It defines functions for packet serialization, deserialization, tracing, and sideband communication used in Git's protocol.

methods.name: void packet_trace_identity(const char * prog)
methods.description: Sets the trace prefix for packet tracing, duplicating the program name.

methods.name: const char * get_trace_prefix(void)
methods.description: Returns the current trace prefix, depending on whether the process is async or not.

methods.name: int packet_trace_pack(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int sideband)
methods.description: Traces a packet buffer with optional sideband demultiplexing.

methods.name: void packet_trace(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int write)
methods.description: Handles tracing of packet data, including special packet markers like 'PACK'.

methods.name: void packet_flush(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a flush packet, tracing it beforehand.

methods.name: void packet_delim(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a delim packet, with trace.

methods.name: void packet_response_end(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a response end packet, with trace.

methods.name: int packet_flush_gently(int fd)
methods.description: Attempts to flush a packet gently, returns error code on failure.

methods.name: void packet_buf_flush(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a flush packet marker to a string buffer, with trace.

methods.name: void packet_buf_delim(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a delimiter packet marker to a string buffer, with trace.

methods.name: void set_packet_header(char * buf,int size)
methods.description: Sets the header of a packet (size in hex).

methods.name: void format_packet(struct strbuf * out,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Formats a detailed packet with prefix and variadic arguments, with tracing.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_1(int fd,int gently,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet to a file descriptor; can be gentle (non-fatal) on failure.

methods.name: void packet_write_fmt(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a variadic formatted packet to a file descriptor.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_gently(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Same as above, but fails gently.

methods.name: int do_packet_write(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Performs low-level packet writing with header and data, tracing included.

methods.name: int packet_write_gently(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Wrapper to write a packet gently, logs error on failure.

methods.name: void packet_write(int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Fatal variant to write a packet; dies on error.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite(FILE * f,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite_fmt(FILE * fh,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fflush(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_buf_write(struct strbuf * buf,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats a packet into a string buffer.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush(int fd_in,int fd_out)
methods.description: Reads data from input FD and writes as packets to output FD, without flushing.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count(const char * src_in,size_t len,int fd_out,int * packet_counter)
methods.description: Writes data from buffer as packets, counting packets; no flush.

methods.name: int get_packet_data(int fd,char ** src_buf,size_t * src_size,void * dst,size_t size,int options)
methods.description: Reads packet data from a file descriptor or buffer, with error handling and options.

methods.name: int packet_length(const char lenbuf_hex[4],size_t size)
methods.description: Decodes packet length from a hex buffer.

methods.name: char * find_packfile_uri_path(const char * buffer)
methods.description: Finds and redacts packfile URI path in a packet buffer.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_read_with_status(int fd,char ** src_buffer,size_t * src_len,char * buffer,unsigned size,int * pktlen,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet with detailed status, handles sidebands, errors, and special packets.

methods.name: int packet_read(int fd,char * buffer,unsigned size,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet, returning its length.

methods.name: char * packet_read_line(int fd,int * dst_len)
methods.description: Reads a line packet, chomps newline.

methods.name: int packet_read_line_gently(int fd,int * dst_len,char ** dst_line)
methods.description: Reads a line packet gently, also gives line pointer.

methods.name: ssize_t read_packetized_to_strbuf(int fd_in,struct strbuf * sb_out,int options)
methods.description: Reads multiple packets into a string buffer.

methods.name: int recv_sideband(const char * me,int in_stream,int out)
methods.description: Receives sideband packets and demultiplexes, writing primary data to output.

methods.name: void packet_reader_init(struct packet_reader * reader,int fd,char * src_buffer,size_t src_len,int options)
methods.description: Initializes a packet reader structure.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_read(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads a packet via packet reader, handling sidebands and status.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_peek(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet, reading it into the buffer but not advancing.

methods.name: void packet_writer_init(struct packet_writer * writer,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Initializes a packet writer structure.

methods.name: void packet_writer_write(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet via packet writer.

methods.name: void packet_writer_error(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes an error packet and message.

methods.name: void packet_writer_delim(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet.

methods.name: void packet_writer_flush(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Flushes packets to the output.
